entry.title: Acquire lro-lola-gdr-south-pole-selection
entry.summary: recorded:5-steps for Shackleton rim rehearsal tile near 89.88S, 0.12E: The active software-proof fixtures must keep product family URL, metadata URL, selected product URL, SHA-256, extraction windows, and generated CSV checksums recorded.

payload.expected_format: PDS LOLA GDR south-polar gridded elevation product selected through ODE/PDS metadata
payload.trust_gate: The active software-proof fixtures must keep product family URL, metadata URL, selected product URL, SHA-256, extraction windows, and generated CSV checksums recorded.

steps.title: Confirm product family
steps.action: Use the PDS LOLA page and Lunar ODE to confirm the south-polar GDR float product is the right first authoritative terrain source.
steps.expected_evidence: Official PDS page URL, ODE discovery URL, GDR family URL, and GDR catalog URL.
steps.done_when: The source candidate points to a named product family and the acquisition plan names a reachable PDS family root.

steps.title: Fetch metadata first
steps.action: Download the GDR catalog before any large image and record the selected product route, projection assumptions, units, byte order, and map scale.
steps.expected_evidence: A local GDR catalog file with SHA-256 recorded in the authoritative dataset manifest draft.
steps.done_when: The extractor can derive pixel coordinates for the trusted-square bounds without reading the full image into memory.

steps.title: Extract tiny tile
steps.action: Read only the needed south-pole window from the float image and emit a compact CSV for the first trusted square.
steps.expected_evidence: A small CSV under data/sources/lro_lola with source product id, bounds, resolution, and SHA-256.
steps.done_when: scripts/generate_moonmoon_fixture.py regenerates MoonBit terrain from the authoritative CSV.

steps.title: Verify evidence chain
steps.action: Check raw label checksum, raw image checksum when available, extracted CSV checksum, and generated inline grid fingerprint.
steps.expected_evidence: A passing source verification script and a DatasetValidation with status verified.
steps.done_when: moon test passes while the dossier marks the authoritative dataset as accepted for software proof.

steps.title: Human review before mission claims
steps.action: Review projection math, elevation units, polar singularity handling, and traverse thresholds before raising claim kind beyond derived software evidence.
steps.expected_evidence: MoonBook review notes tied to the dataset, terrain metrics, and traverse decision.
steps.done_when: The source-upgrade blocker is closed and remaining review focuses on terrain hazards, illumination, and route alternatives.
